worklist.title: Worklist
worklist.subtitle: Ordered tests of the collection window: who is waiting for a result, how late it is, and where to enter it.
worklist.note: Rows are coloured by the share of the test's turnaround time already consumed (BR-13). Verified and printed tests keep no colour.
worklist.searchPlaceholder: Accession, sample, patient no. or name… (Ctrl+K)
worklist.loadError: The worklist could not be loaded.
worklist.emptyHint: Widen the collection window or clear the status boxes.
worklist.documentTruncated: The list was cut at the maximum number of rows; narrow the filter for the rest.
case.title: Results by accession
case.subtitle: Find a visit, enter and review its results per report unit, verify them and print the laboratory report.
case.queryHelp: Leave every field empty to list the latest visits. Enter or F8 runs the query; a row of the list opens the visit.
case.noNeighbour: No {direction} visit in the matching list.
case.discardMessage: {count} entered values are not saved. Leave the visit and discard them?
case.discardMessageOne: One entered value is not saved. Leave the visit and discard it?
case.densitySaveFailed: The row density could not be saved; it applies to this page only.
case.searchError: The visits could not be searched.
case.startHint: Type an accession, a patient number or a name and press F8, or open a visit from the worklist.
case.noMatchHint: Check the accession or widen the registration window and the status boxes.
case.selectVisitHint: Pick a visit from the matching list to see its results.
case.hiddenUnits: {count} report units are outside your result rights
case.hiddenUnitsOne: 1 report unit is outside your result rights
case.noUnitsHint: The visit has no ordered test in a clinical group you may see.
case.gridHelp: Enter moves to the next result, Shift+Enter to the previous one, F10 saves the unit. Pink = high, orange = low, red = panic value. Values are entered only on received samples (BR-03); verified values change only through Amend.
case.nothingToVerify: No result to verify: enter a value first.
case.nothingToUndo: Nothing to undo: no reviewed or verified result you may undo (printed results are amended).
case.refusedCount: {count} results were refused; see the codes on the rows.
case.refusedCountOne: 1 result was refused; see the code on the row.
case.printed: The report of {accession} was marked printed and sent to the printer.
case.deltaMessage: These results differ from the patient's previous verified result beyond the test's delta limit (BR-11). Check the sample and the patient identity before signing. Verifying acknowledges the flags:
case.undoMessage: {count} results return to the previous status. The removed review or signature stays in the result log. Give the reason:
case.undoMessageOne: 1 result returns to the previous status. The removed review or signature stays in the result log. Give the reason:
case.printVipBlocked: Printing a VIP patient's report needs the See-VIP right.
case.amended: The result was amended and returned to Complete; it needs a new verification.
grid.caption: Results of the report unit
grid.formulaHint: Computed from its input tests; not typed.
amend.title: Amend a verified result
amend.warning: The result returns to Complete with the new value and needs a new verification. The previous value and signature stay in the result log; the printed report will carry the amendment count.
note.title: Internal note
note.label: Note
note.hint: Seen by the laboratory staff only; never printed on the report.
delta.title: Acknowledge the delta flag
delta.hint: Confirms that the change against the previous result was checked (sample, patient identity, clinical context). The value is not changed.
comment.title: Report comment
comment.printsOnReport: prints under the test on the laboratory report
culture.title: Culture result
text.title: Formatted text result
history.title: Result history
history.noPrevious: No previous verified result of this test for the patient.
